comment: task recipe-b6b-small-maps-cnc-assembler-nanofab — the Nanoscale Fabricator stock (Loader_Recipes_Other.java:818-894, the Graphene shapes + Loader_Recipes_Ores.java:341-344, the Dolamide/Dilithium gems): 41 + 4 rows, all port-registered carriers (live registration walk: foil/plate/plateCurved/casingSmall/wireFine/bolt/stick/stickLong/ring/gearGtSmall/gearGt/rotor x Graphene, dust-family x C/Dolamide/Dilithium, gem x Dilithium). The ST.tag(0..17) circuit selector legs are DROPPED (the press.json:2 form) — DECLARED DEVIATION: the same carbon dust input recurs across shape groups (e.g. dust_tiny_carbon x9 selects foil/plate/plateCurved/wireFine/bolt/stick/stickLong/ring/gearGtSmall by circuit config upstream), so the shape a live machine answers is the recipe-set iteration order, NOT the upstream circuit config; JSON v1 cannot express the configured circuit. DECLARED SKIPS (unregistered port carriers): the wireGt01 legs :841-844 (OP.wireGt01 is not in the port item-path prefix set) and the five pipe-size legs :876-879/:881-883/:885-887/:889-891/:893-894 (the pipeTiny..pipeHuge prefixes ride the un-ported block path). The NBT-copy semantics face stays POOLED with the Printer/Replicator domain (the GT6RecipeMaps.ASSEMBLER/PRINTER field docs). KJS: datapack domain, zero adaptation.
